mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized by CYP2C19 to meprobamate; while ethinyl estradiol does not directly inhibit this pathway, concurrent use may increase CNS depression and theoretical estrogen level fluctuations due to hepatic metabolism competition.
action: Monitor for enhanced CNS depression (drowsiness, dizziness); counsel patients to avoid driving and alcohol; consider alternative muscle relaxants if CNS effects are problematic; standard oral contraceptive monitoring is appropriate.
